shared_elements: file/procession of figures moving in one direction
justification: Both show low-relief horizontal friezes of bearded, profile-view human figures in long garments arranged in overlapping files advancing in a single direction and carrying objects in their hands, with similar shallow-carving conventions, flat overlapping planes and consistent figure proportions. The subject matter differs sharply, however: A is a peaceful multi-register procession including a tree and led animals (ram/bovid), while B is a single-register military assault with drawn bows, a wheeled siege engine and a crenellated fortification.
